questions.prompt: What information makes an invitation usable?
questions.answer: Activity, time, location or format, cost, expectations and response route.

questions.prompt: Should a refusal require personal justification?
questions.answer: Not for an ordinary voluntary invitation.
State uncertainty and verify with the appropriate organiser or venue.

scoring.knowledge: 1 point per correct answer; formative only; use answer-specific feedback.
scoring.practice: Writes clear, accessible, voluntary invitations with transparent logistics and proportionate follow-up.
scoring.transfer: Design two fictional inclusive invitations: one recurring community activity and one one-off social gathering. Include confirmed logistics, access uncertainty, cost, RSVP, an opt-out and an appropriate follow-up rule. Compare how the format changes with context.
scoring.pass: All mapped criteria require Level 2 evidence; no averaging away omissions or safety-critical criteria. No automatic competency award.
